items.reason: A fragrance-free, active-free cleanser that cleans without stripping dry, sensitive-looking skin.
A ceramide moisturizer to support the skin barrier and add comfort to skin that scans low on moisture.
A tinted mineral SPF 50 with iron oxides that gently softens the look of redness and protects skin from sun, which can make a flushed look more visible.

response.routine_note: Because the redness is constant, we'd suggest having a dermatologist look at it before adding more products, and we've left out the vitamin C serum and glycolic toner since strong actives can sting dry, sensitive skin. Use the cleanser and moisturizer morning and night, with the tinted SPF as the last step each morning.
